remarks: Discover this delightful 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom rental in the heart of Norwalk. Ideally situated just moments from downtown, this home offers a spacious, light-filled living area perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The kitchen is equipped with updated appliances and ample counter space, while the three generously sized bedrooms provide cozy areas with plenty of closet space. Two well-maintained bathrooms to ensure comfort. Take advantage of nearby shops, restaurants, and entertainment options. This charming rental is a rare find, blending peacefulness with lively city energy.  *Note: Countertop in kitchen will be replaced prior to lease start date.
